notes: The program page links to the Transition Alliance Program (TAP). It does not describe TAP. Work-based learning is one part of Pre-ETS. The program page does not say if the work is paid.
name: Pre-Employment Transition Services (Pre-ETS)
org: Iowa Vocational Rehabilitation Services, Iowa Workforce Development
what_you_do: Students with disabilities explore careers, build work skills and try real work. You also get help planning for college or job training. You learn to speak up for yourself.
who_can_apply: Students with a disability who are 14 to 21 years old. Talk to your school staff or your Vocational Rehabilitation high school contact to sign up.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. You can start working with the program once you turn 14.
how_to_apply: Talk with your school staff or your Vocational Rehabilitation high school contact. You can also apply online, with a paper form, or at your local office. Call 1-800-532-1486 with questions.
